cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -1.09% · WTI +0.98% · Brent +3.42% · NatGas -3.62%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Shale & E&P is doing the heavy lifting at +3.66%.

cards.headline: Shale & E&P leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Shale & E&P at +3.66%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.21%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at -15.28%
cards.body: Leaders: AR +6.06%, EQNR +5.10%, OVV +4.66%, TRGP +4.34%, FANG +4.27%. Laggards: EOSE -15.28%, FLNC -9.77%, LEU -9.50%, OKLO -6.72%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
